text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-ah... I wonder if I'm actually 
getting faster.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I've hit a plateau lately, or 
something... *sigh* It's so 
frustrating~..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!! Don't step on that magic circle~~!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A magic circle? Oh, this thing drawn 
on the ground?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wait... Huh!? Where is this place!? Wait, 
Vodka!? When did you—

text_block_list.name: Vodka?
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~, Scarlet~! If ya wanna be number 
one, just try and catch me~♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... Caught you. Number one 
belongs to me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka?
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, that was quite a fightback! You're 
pretty good!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
H-Hmph... What's with you, praising me so 
straightforwardly all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well? The footing was poor, so I paid 
extra attention to how I was running 
compared to usual... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't scare me like that! Standing on 
the magic circle and going completely 
quiet, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(A magic circle? Could it be that just 
now, the power of magic...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Just kidding, yeah... No way, absolutely 
not.)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, sorry for making you worry. I was 
just a little tired and zoned out.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But... thanks to that, I think I just got 
a little inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'll definitely beat her in the 
real race...!
